name: Daily Status Settings
description: How the daily status works: who is asked for one, when they are asked, and who gets the evening digest. The whole feature is one chat room per person — this page only decides who and when.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Off by default. Nothing is generated, nudged or emailed until this is on.

fields.label: Who Reports
fields.description: Everyone holding one of these roles gets a status room and appears in the digest.

fields.label: Only People Who Were On Duty
fields.description: On: only people with a duty punch that day are asked and counted, so leave is not a missed report. Off (default): everyone holding a reporting role. Turn this on only once every depot reliably punches in — until then it would quietly drop the people who work but do not punch.

fields.label: Day Starts At (IST hour)
fields.description: A night shift that runs past midnight belongs to the day it started. 4 means the status day runs 04:00 to 04:00 IST.

fields.label: The Reminder
fields.description: A short message posted into the person's own status room, with a push notification. It asks three plain questions, which is also what gives the summary something to work with.

fields.label: Reminder Text
fields.default:
How did the day go?
1. What did you finish today?
2. What is still running?
3. Anything stuck or needed for tomorrow?

Reply here — typing or a voice note, whichever is quicker.
fields.description: Keep it short and in plain language. It is read on a phone, at the end of a shift.

fields.label: Organise With AI
fields.description: Sorts the day's messages into finished / running / stuck. Uses Azure OpenAI when it is enabled, otherwise ONYX. When neither is reachable the day is still recorded and still emailed, just rendered plainly.

fields.label: Messages Per Summary
fields.description: A cap on how much of a very talkative day is sent to the AI. The full text is always kept on the record regardless.

fields.label: The Digest
fields.description: One email per depot listing everyone's day, blockers first — not one email per person, which is how a daily report gets filtered away in a week.

fields.label: Send To Roles
fields.description: Resolved to users at send time. A recipient only receives the depots they are attached to, unless they hold Central Ops or System Manager, who get every depot.

fields.label: Also Send To
fields.description: Named people who get every depot's digest regardless of role.

fields.label: List People Who Did Not Report
fields.description: Recommended. A digest that only shows who replied quietly hides the ones who did not.

fields.label: Search
fields.description: Push each finished day into ONYX as a document, so anyone can ask it questions later — "what were the blockers at this depot last week?" — from ONYX's own search. Needs an ONYX API key with curator rights.

fields.label: ONYX Connector Id
fields.description: The connector-credential pair to file these documents under in ONYX. Leave 0 for the default ingestion connector.
